g.text: The orbit of one and compatible residue states

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #20343c

g.text: Cell labels give n in the orbit n · (1, 1), from 0 to period − 1.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #20343c

g.text: Teal cells are compatible; hatched cells violate agreement on the shared factor.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #20343c

g.text: For 6 and 10, the two residues must have equal parity. Capacity is lcm, not the raw product.
